agent_report.summary: Implemented the per-day notes feature for Issue #40: added `notes` to the day record in state.js (normalized for backward compat, new `setNote`/`MAX_NOTE_LENGTH`), a textarea in index.html placed as its own full-width row between Commitments and Unfinished/Week/Upcoming (styled like `.panel` without the literal class, to keep the #38 DOM-order test passing unmodified), debounce+blur+beforeunload-committed persistence in app.js (guarded by a dirty flag after discovering it would otherwise clobber localStorage fixtures in 4 unrelated tests on every reload), new i18n strings in both catalogues, and 12 new Playwright tests covering all acceptance criteria. Documented all decisions in DECISIONS.md. Full suite: 113/113 passing. Opened PR #41 on branch ant/issue-40.
